role: Federal agency providing traffic capacity standards
stance_basis: cited as technical standards source for level of service 'C' definition, no position expressed
summary: The Federal Highway Administration is referenced solely as the publisher of the Highway Capacity Manual, which defines the level of service 'C' standard used to evaluate Main Street traffic performance under the proposed LRRT configuration. The FHA is also cited for its noise standard PPM 90-2 recommending that L10 values not exceed 70 dBA near parkland. Neither citation reflects a position for or against the project.
complaint_summary: The Federal Highway Administration is cited as the source of the Highway Capacity Manual, which defines level of service 'C' used to assess whether Main Street can handle projected traffic under the LRRT mixed-traffic configuration.
summary_quote: Main Street should perform at level of service 'C,' as defined by the Highway Capacity Manual prepared by the Federal Highway Administration.
